name: L1 Global Long Short Fund Limited
summary: L1 Global Long Short Fund Limited is a closed-ended equity mutual fund launched and managed by L1 Capital Pty. Limited. It invests in the public equity markets across the globe. The fund invests in stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. It invests in value stocks of companies. The fund employs fundamental analysis with a bottom up approach to create its portfolio. It benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the MSCI All Country World Net Index. L1 Global Long Short Fund Limited was founded on June 29, 1994 and is domiciled in Australia.
